name: KH1FM Dual Wield Prototype v3

runtime_scope.ground_and_air: ability-free Valor base rows; ground hop rows excluded
runtime_scope.idle_and_run: Valor poses over native grounded idle/run slots and native clocks
runtime_scope.casting: visual-only Master body/weapon sampling over observed native KH1 casts
runtime_scope.grip: hand-local axes; bind translations excluded; native right grip calibration retained
runtime_scope.weapon: duplicate current KH1 weapon; no secondary selection or inventory claim
runtime_scope.appearance: native Sora model/textures/colours; animation pose changes only
runtime_scope.contacts: both blades by default; offhand_only_test isolates left imported ground/air melee
runtime_scope.trail: per-hand attack windows, same-tick posed left emitter, all-exit retirement; no enemy required
runtime_scope.pose: exact actor-instance identity, actor-anchored placement, casting donor root removed

limitations: No local KH2 installation: optional real-data tests did not exercise their data paths.
Windows DLL cross-compiled on Linux, not executed inside KH1 here.
Palm alignment and actual run/casting overlays require fresh-process game validation.
Normalized donor timing preserves native events but does not prove visual release-marker alignment.
Master weapon motion may float during casting; no new form or spell logic is activated.
Different KH1 weapon lengths, contacts, native rendering and map transitions require gameplay verification.
Old offhand Lua/model assets and full combat overhaul must be disabled.
